latest_release.name: GitHub CLI 2.104.0
latest_release.body:
## Protect private forks when deleting repositories

`gh repo delete` now warns when deleting a private or internal repository will also delete its forks. The additional confirmation is required even with `--yes`.

Non-interactive workflows and agents must explicitly accept the cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

## What's Changed

### ✨ Features

* Require confirmation before `gh repo delete` deletes private forks by @BagToad in [#14858](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14858)

### 🐛 Fixes

* fix(auth status): surface underlying rate-limit, server, and network errors in terminal output by @babakks and @Copilot in [#15009](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15009)
* fix(auth): skip token refresh when `gh`'s state directory is not writable by @babakks in [#14845](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14845)

### 📚 Docs & Chores

* Use REST to apply issue triage labels by @BagToad in [#15041](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15041)
* Prevent repeated Dependabot triage assessments by @BagToad in [#15002](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15002)
* Apply issue triage labels directly by @BagToad in [#15001](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15001)
* Provide verified build versions to issue triage by @BagToad in [#15000](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/15000)
* Use a synthetic namespace for triage fixtures by @BagToad in [#14976](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14976)
* Remove the accidental issue-triage model pin by @BagToad in [#14972](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14972)
* Add a fake GitHub API runner for reproductions by @BagToad in [#14951](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14951)
* Clarify which hosts use `GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN` by @BagToad in [#14918](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14918)
* Regenerate triage workflows with `gh-aw` v1.0.1 by @tidy-dev in [#14910](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14910)
* Test the `ShowRefs` option separator by @BagToad in [#14879](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14879)
* Fix local extension-install test path normalization by @bobrik in [#14854](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14854)
* Save Go caches only from trunk by @williammartin in [#14840](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14840)
* Add a private vulnerability report form by @BagToad in [#14825](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14825)
* Replace `msgpack` with a minimal node ID encoder by @tj-smith47 in [#14801](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14801)
* Test the Git client with real repositories by @williammartin in [#14348](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14348)
